questions.source: Laxmikanth 8th ed. appendix · Practice Questions (Question Set II) Q195
questions.question_en:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes:
List-I (Acts) List-II (Provisions)
A. Indian Councils Act of 1861. 1. Introduced Dyarchy
B. Government of India Act of 1919 2. Placed Indian affairs under the direct control of the British
Government.
C. Indian Councils Act of 1892 3. Introduced representative institutions.
D. Pitt’s India Act of 1784 4. Introduced provincial autonomy.
5. Introduced the principle of election.
Codes: A B C D
